What if you slept without a pillow?
Most people have slept with a pillow their whole life. Some people swear by it. A pillow's job is to keep your head and neck in line with your spine.

But here's the twist. It can help stomach sleepers keep their neck straighter, but for back and side sleepers, it can bend your neck the wrong way and leave you stiff! Side sleepers usually need the thickest pillow, to fill the gap by the shoulder.
